content:
nina-peopleops: Brainstorm: small 'Gratitude Kiosk' for the week before holidays. Purpose: quick nominations, sticker wall, and 12 micro spot awards ($50 e-gift). Want hybrid-friendly setup. Volunteers?
jules-culture: I'm in. Can do onsite setup Tue-Fri mornings.
omar-hr: Quick policy check: gift amount <$100 should be de minimis but I'll confirm with payroll and add a note to the form.
kevin-logistics: Logistics OK. Need a kiosk sign, tablet or printed form, and a small table. I'll reserve assets.
tara-support: Happy to run the virtual table Thurs. I'll monitor the form and Slack thread.
kudos-bot: New nomination by li-engr: "Tara stayed late to help fix customer issue" :sparkles:
li-engr: tagging to save for the award pool.
nina-peopleops: Thanks! Draft plan: nomination form + physical dropbox, volunteers rota, panel of 3 to pick winners, announce at Dec town hall.
omar-hr: Panel recusal rule: if you nominate, you abstain from deliberation for that nominee. I'll add a short blurb.
jules-culture: I'll handle sticker wall and small print run for 100 mini-cards.
kevin-logistics: Estimated cost: $150 supplies + 12*$50 = $750. Approve from culture budget?
nina-peopleops: We have $800 in discretionary Q4 culture. OK to proceed.
tara-support: I'll take Thurs virtual shift 11-1.
li-engr: I'll cover Wed onsite 12-2 and bring extra markers.
nina-peopleops: Action list: 1) form & copy (Nina) 2) asset booking (Kevin) 3) panel volunteers (Omar, Jules, Li) 4) promo post (Jules). Please reply when done.
kevin-logistics: Assets booked.
omar-hr: Panel confirmed. I'll finalize recusal language and send to payroll.
jules-culture: Promo draft posted in #general.
nina-peopleops: Final note: winners get e-gift + shoutout. If anyone wants to sponsor extra gifts reply here. Tagging @here for visibility.
